name: keyharbor
description: Sign in to websites, create accounts and run commands that need API keys, with secrets kept in the user's local KeyHarbor vault.

interface.shortDescription: Agents sign in and use secrets without seeing them
interface.longDescription: KeyHarbor keeps passwords, API keys and cards in a local encrypted vault on the user's Mac. The agent drives a dedicated browser profile and types {{secret:item.field}} placeholders; KeyHarbor fills the values on the right site and masks them in everything the agent reads back. This plugin teaches the agent the sign-in, sign-up, env secret and handoff flows.
defaultPrompt: Sign in to GitHub in my work session and open my notifications.
Run the tests with the myapp env secrets.
Create an account on this site with a generated password.
